text:
jamie-sales: Prospect (global bank) asked if we can run a 5-week air-gapped POC. Key asks: USB-only delivery, signature verification docs, and a one-page security checklist for procurement. Who can help make a thumbprint-ready packet?

emma-ps: I can assemble a POC kit. Need clarity on model licensing for quantized weights during POC and whether they expect weekly patches.

sanjay-se: Tech constraints: offline bundle flow supported. We provide: signed bundles, checksums, and a verification kit. Minimal example: `sha256sum -c checksums.txt && ./redwood-verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz`.

lena-sec: Security: telemetry off by default. We require chain-of-custody for USB handoff and an attested SBOM. If they require Redwood-managed signing keys that's an enterprise-only option.

emma-ps: Pricing note: one-time packaging fee for quantization + 6 PS hours included. If they convert to Dedicated in 30 days we can credit 20% of PS.

jamie-sales: Buyer wants a short runbook to hand to their SecOps. Can we produce a 1-page install + verify + rollback summary by EOD?

sanjay-se: I'll draft it: preflight (inventory, offline creds), install (`./install.sh --offline --bundle bundle.tar.gz`), verify (checksums + `redwood-verify`), apply delta (`./apply_delta.sh delta.tar.gz`), rollback (`kubectl rollout undo`).

lena-sec: I'll write the security checklist: SBOM attestation, HSM/KMS guidance (BYOK supported), key-rotation policy template, and audit-log export procedure.

opsbot: system: offline-bundle v3.1 built; detached signature ready (sha256: a1b2...e7f0).

emma-ps: I'll bundle the runbook + verification kit + pricing anchor and send to Jamie for review in 3 hours.

jamie-sales: Perfect. I'll ask procurement for SCCM contact and try to get the completed questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all. :pray:
